title: Save clipboard content to a file in Wayland
summary: Use wl-paste with redirection to save the current clipboard content directly into a text file. This is handy for quickly capturing copied text without opening an editor.

aliases.text: сохранить буфер обмена в файл wayland
записать буфер обмена в файл linux

steps.explain: Run wl-paste and redirect the output to a file path of your choice.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file where you want to save the clipboard content.

steps.expect: The command completes silently, and the specified file now contains the clipboard text.
